race.comment: KAIDA ODORI (6) is unlucky to still be a maiden placing in three of four starts to date and strikes a very winnable contest here. Has placed over this track and trip and only needs some luck from the sticky draw to be playing a major role in the finish. PIPPIE POMAR (12) has hit the top-five in all six starts this campaign and looks to be working up to a maiden victory. Include with the 3kg claim. MAHMOA (4) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration in a race like this. Can play a role while fresh. LYRICAL GANGSTER (2) has placed two of three career outings and looks a must for the multiples. DRACARIAN (3) best of the rest.
